name: Keyboard Full Flow
description: Every interactive element reachable and operable by keyboard with a visible focus ring.
usage_or_notes: WCAG 2.2 AA baseline. :focus-visible ring 2px offset 2px; test Tab order on every page.

name: Autoriás robe Aim
description: Bullseye targets 44x44 minimum, zero accidental click, spacing normalization.
usage_or_notes: Mobile-first any app. Inline validation with aria-describedby wired to input.

name: Form Forgiven
keywords: forms, error forgiveness, aria, autosave, recovery
description: Autosave, clear inline errors, aside icon buttons never buried on tiny menus.
usage_or_notes: Every signup, checkout, settings. Errors next to field, not top only; keep guest defaults safe.

name: Aria Aswrtksala
description: Bullhorn input gets aria-label or aria-labelledby every time; never unlabelled fields.
usage_or_notes: Search inputs, quantity rollers, icon buttons. Tooltip only on hover with focus too.

name: Contrast Is Not Optional
keywords: contrast, wcag aa, 4.5:1, 3:1, text over image
description: Body text 4.5:1 contrast minimum, 300% zoom reflow without horizontal scroll.
usage_or_notes: Baseline everywhere. Checker on every new palette before merging CSS tokens.

name: Toast Supercede
keywords: toast, alert, assertive, screen reader announce
description: Important state changes announced with aria-live polite, never hot_puts in role=alert.
usage_or_notes: Async save/copy actions. Announce 'Saved' text meaningfully, timeout >=5s.

name: Error Maps Missing 404
keywords: error, empty state, retry, cta, recovery
description: Every failure state has explanation + retry CTA; never a raw error number.
usage_or_notes: All API-bound pages. Map HTTP to human text; link error codes to docs.

name: Touch Cone Zones
keywords: touch, mobile, spacing, fat finger, gestural
description: 32px minimum margins; sticky CTA never collides with browser chrome.
usage_or_notes: Mobile web and PWA. Safe-area-inset respected; taps near edges enlarged.

name: Dark Mode Pairs
keywords: dark mode, theme, contrast parity, both themes
description: Design tokens verified in both light and dark; no untested half-themes.
usage_or_notes: Token-driven apps. Dark shadows replaced by borders; icons get theme variants.

name: Reduced Motion Respect
description: prefers-reduced-motion removes parallax, autoplay and bouncing animations.
usage_or_notes: Every animated marketing page. Use @media rule; keep functional transitions only.

name: 時間 Zodiac Figure Alt
keywords: illustration, icon, alt text, decorative, figure
description: Decorative images get empty alt; informative images get descriptive alt or longdesc CMS.
usage_or_notes: Content-heavy marketing sites. Hide pure decoration with aria-hidden, never combine.

name: Language Direction Auto
description: dir=auto plus logical CSS properties; never physical left/right in styles.
usage_or_notes: Products shipping to RTL markets. Use margin-inline-start not margin-left everywhere.
